title: AERON_flight_model material extension
description: What the game draws on a material beyond its glTF definition: frames played on game states, hull damage, energy effects and live screens. Frames and damage stages are image keys of effect libraries, which the models share (animated_materials.md). Unknown fields are ignored.

flipbooks.title: Flipbooks
flipbooks.description: Frames the material plays on game states, in order: per layer, the first flipbook whose state is active plays.

energy.title: Energy effects
energy.description: The energy effects the material shows: any of shields (shield hits and shields going down), tractor and jamming (beams); an empty array shows none. Without it, the model root's energy applies, and without that, none.

skins.title: Skins
skins.description: The material's skin layers, keyed by skin name. The model root's skinVariants combine them; the cooker composites each combination. A viewer without this extension shows the material as defined.

skinLayer.title: Skin layer
skinLayer.description: The images of one skin on this material, in the texture coordinates of its base color texture. The base color texture's alpha is the layer's coverage for every channel.

baseColorTexture.description: RGB: the layer's base color. Alpha: its coverage.

emissiveTexture.description: The layer's emissive color; without it, the layer leaves the emissive unchanged.

metallicRoughnessTexture.description: The layer's metallic (B) and roughness (G); without it, the layer leaves them unchanged.

emissiveStrength.title: Emissive strength
emissiveStrength.description: The KHR_materials_emissive_strength of the layer's emissive. Default: the material's, or 1.

textureInfo.title: Texture reference
textureInfo.description: A glTF texture of this file. Its sampler and any texCoord or KHR_texture_transform are ignored: a layer uses those of the material's texture.

key.title: Image key
key.description: The key of an image of the effect library.

library.title: Library
library.description: The name of an effect library: the game loads it from remaster/effects/<library>.yaml.

state.title: State
state.description: always, or a game state of the player's craft: target (a target is selected), laser_lock, warhead.locking, warhead.locked, threat.* (a threat of that kind), hull.75/50/25 (the hull at or below that level), cannon.1 to cannon.8 (the cannon that fired), broken.* (the system is damaged), hangar (in a hangar).

flipbook.title: Flipbook
flipbook.description: Frames played from the moment a state becomes active (always: from the start).

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: What the frames change. baseColor frames are painted over the base colour by their alpha. emissive frames replace the material's emissive, and a frame's optional base colour is painted over the base colour. The frames are library images of the same kind.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: loop repeats the frames; once holds the last frame.

library.description: The effect library of the frames; required with frames.

frames.title: Frames
frames.description: The frames in order, each [image key, seconds shown].

emissiveStrength.title: Emissive strength
emissiveStrength.description: The brightness of emissive frames, a multiplier of their colour.

unlit.title: Unlit part
unlit.description: Base colour frames: the part of the frames drawn unlit, as emission in place of the material's (0 to 1).

damage.title: Hull damage
damage.description: Images the material shows as the hull weakens, multiplying its base colour (their alpha dulls the surface). Each object picks one alternative and places it at random.

library.description: The effect library of the damage images.

choice.title: Choice group
choice.description: Materials of an object with the same choice pick the same alternative.

placement.title: Placement group
placement.description: Materials of an object with the same placement share the random size and offset.

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description: The alternatives an object picks from.

damageAlternative.title: Damage alternative
damageAlternative.description: One set of damage images and their placement.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: The images (of kind damage) shown at 75, 50 and 25% hull; null shows none.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: [min, max]: the image covers a square whose side is random between them, as a fraction of the texture, centred. Without it, the whole texture.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Moves the square: inside, anywhere within the texture; or a range, by min + (max - min) * r per axis, r random in [0, 1). Without it, the square stays centred. Outside the square the stage shows nothing; the square is clipped at the texture's edges.

min.title: Minimum
min.description: The smallest [x, y] offset, as a fraction of the texture.

max.title: Maximum
max.description: The largest [x, y] offset, as a fraction of the texture.

screenRect.title: Screen rectangle
screenRect.description: One of the game's displays, shown on a rectangle of the material's TEXCOORD_0 space.

dst.title: Rectangle
dst.description: [u0, v0, u1, v1] in TEXCOORD_0; swapped corners mirror it.

bg.description: The background in the display's normal state.

highlight.description: The background while the display is highlighted.

lock.description: The background while the display shows a lock.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: What it shows, a bitmask: 1 the display's graphics, 2 its text, 4 a fill bar (no texture).

bar.description: The fill bar's colour; required with layer 4.

screen.title: Screen
screen.description: Displays the game draws live on the material (cockpit screens).

cover.title: Cover
cover.description: The base colour's alpha below 1 shows the screen through the material.

transparent.title: Transparent
transparent.description: Drawn unlit, its alpha from the screen's luminance.

alwaysVisible.title: Always visible
alwaysVisible.description: A transparent screen kept while the game draws its 2D HUD.

hide.title: Hidden HUD regions
hide.description: A bitmask of the 2D HUD regions the game stops drawing while the screen shows (game-defined).
